title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 54-52 - Public Employees Retirement System
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 54 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t54.html): chapter row '54-52' with name 'Public Employees Retirement System', no '[Repealed]' marker; then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t54c52.html, which lists sections from 54-52-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: The state's defined-benefit plan (NDPERS). The companion defined-contribution plan is ch. 54-52.6 and the deferred compensation plan ch. 54-52.2, both verified in force on the same index. Old-age, survivors and disability insurance is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7); N.D.C.C. ch. 52-10 only covers bringing state employees under federal Social Security, and the former state old-age chapter 52-09 is marked [Repealed].
